info.name: Karmasheel API
info.description:
Week 1-5 Karmasheel API walkthrough: public taxonomy, worker/employer authentication, profiles (including CV generation), jobs, applications (status state machine), ratings, and the explainable recommendation engine. See docs/postman/POSTMAN_WALKTHROUGH.md for setup and run order.

Uses the Karmasheel_Local environment for all variables - no secrets are stored in this collection file itself.

item.name: Update Worker Profile and Assign Skills

body.raw:
{
  "address": "Demo Address, Kathmandu",
  "latitude": "27.700000",
  "longitude": "85.330000",
  "experience_years": 3,
  "expected_wage": "1200.00",
  "preferred_travel_radius_km": 25,
  "skill_input": [
    "House Wiring",
    "ghar wiring",
    "Totally Unknown Skill Phrase XYZ"
  ]
}

request.description: skill_input accepts standardized names, English synonyms, and Romanized Nepali aliases; unmatched phrases come back in unmatched_terms and are queued for admin review rather than silently dropped.

exec: pm.test('standardized skill was matched by name', function () { pm.expect(data.skills.map(function (s) { return s.name; })).to.include('House Wiring'); });
pm.test('romanized-Nepali alias also matched to the same standardized skill', function () { pm.expect(data.skills.map(function (s) { return s.name; })).to.include('House Wiring'); });
pm.test('unmatched phrase is surfaced, not silently dropped', function () { pm.expect(data.unmatched_terms).to.include('Totally Unknown Skill Phrase XYZ'); });
